stem.text: Three batteries and three identical resistors are connected in a circuit PQR, as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram of a triangle with corners labelled P, Q and R. Each side contains a resistor and a battery in series. The battery voltages printed are 9.6 V on the side between P and Q, 8.4 V on the side between P and R, and 6.3 V on the side between R and Q.

stem.text: The batteries have negligible internal resistance.
What is the potential difference between points P and Q?
